_about: Content that goes stale on a known date. scripts/check-rechecks.mjs (weekly in CI) fails once a date has passed, until the entry is re-verified and removed or moved. Each entry: the date to recheck on or after, the exam or track key, and what to check.

A new CCDV-F guide is expected (single source). Recheck the domains and weights against it.

Reported CCDV-F exam content update (single source). Recheck the domains and the version-sensitive API claims.

TypeScript 7.1 was in beta on 2026-11-11. Once it is stable, recheck the tooling lessons (es2026 target and lib, the new compiler API, typescript-eslint support) and any claim that says 7.0 has no programmatic API.
Deadline for the fine-tuning jobs described in the course. Recheck the fine-tuning lesson and questions.
